title: Toll and Citation Administration Fees on Courtesy Transportation Agreements
content:
Accounts office schedule for Courtesy Transportation Agreements: the administrative fees added when a toll or a citation incurred with a loaner is passed on to the customer, and which programs' loaners carry a toll transponder.

| Program | Administrative fee per toll transaction passed on | Administrative fee per parking or traffic citation passed on | Loaner carries a toll transponder |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 5.95 | 25.00 | No |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 5.95 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 5.95 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 5.95 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 5.95 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 5.95 | 25.00 | Yes |

## Notes

1. The toll administrative fee is charged per toll transaction passed on; the citation administrative fee is charged per parking or traffic citation passed on. Both are in US dollars and are the same in every program.
2. The transponder column is a switch stating whether the program's loaner carries a toll transponder. Only Same-Day Courtesy Loaner vehicles are shown without one.

## Hypothetical illustration

Suppose, purely for illustration, that three toll transactions and one parking citation are passed on from one agreement. The administrative fees come to three times 5.95, which is 17.85, for the tolls, and 25.00 for the citation, 42.85 in administrative fees in all. The face amounts of the tolls and the citation are separate from these fees and are not shown. The counts of tolls and citations are invented for the example.
